scenario.title: Choose the next useful action
situations: Installation has finished and the user does not know what to ask next.
The user has one concrete change, existing work to resume, or a plan they want staffed.
A mature project has open PRs and work already underway.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: No live install or first-work execution was performed; current cue judgments come from inspected skill text.
Does projectless coordination preserve intent when the user opens the named project folder?
Command nodes, when present, were checked with installed CLI --help only; this proves parser/help availability, not serving-control-plane capability or successful execution.

lessons.title: Route intent, not a command catalog
lessons.when: After project readiness, when the user first asks what to do next or states a concrete work intent.
lessons.need: One known instruction can enter Dash; Charge selects existing runnable work; Steer staffs work from a strategy document. The human names the outcome; the agent reads the selected skill.
lessons.surface: Onboard handoff; router; Help; Dash, Charge and Steer entry skills
lessons.gap: The handoff names Steer/Charge but explains little; Help prints the full registry. Review question: should FIRST-USER C add a two-sentence intent handoff, with JOURNEYS supplying later depth?

lessons.title: Adopt existing work deliberately
lessons.when: During mature-project intake, before proposing new items or taking over an open PR or in-flight change.
lessons.need: Survey accepted docs, repository, open work and permitted external context; identify what Yoke should own now and preserve work it should only observe.
lessons.surface: FIRST-USER inherited-work intake; existing Onboard survey and duplicate check
lessons.gap: FIRST-USER 24 adds scanning but not an explicit takeover boundary. Review question: should it record reuse, leave-running and first-owned-outcome choices before seeding?

lessons.title: Prove first work, not just registration
lessons.when: At the installer-to-project handoff, including when a new session or folder must be opened.
lessons.need: A usable handoff names the correct folder, one next action and how to inspect the resulting work.
lessons.surface: TUI/agent handoff into the project; proposed first-work guide
lessons.gap: Review question: should FIRST-USER D include a scenario from successful handoff through one verified real outcome, beyond its current install checks?
